text: I. Professional Core PositioningThe core of this field is "electronic processing and efficient transmission of information", focusing on how to achieve the collection, encoding, transmission, decoding and application of information such as sound, images and data through electronic devices, circuit systems and communication networks. It also covers the design, integration and intelligent upgrading of electronic equipment. It connects "hardware" (such as chips and circuits) with "software" (such as signal algorithms and communication protocols), and is the foundation of the information technology industry.II. Training ObjectivesTo cultivate comprehensive engineering technical talents with a solid theoretical foundation in electronic information, circuit design capabilities and information processing technologies, who can engage in the research and development of electronic equipment, the design of communication systems, the development of signal processing algorithms, and the manufacturing of intelligent hardware in fields such as communication, electronics, computer science and artificial intelligence. Specific requirements include: Master the core principles of circuit theory, signals and systems, and digital signal processing;Have the ability to design electronic circuits (such as PCB board drawing), develop embedded systems (such as single-chip microcontroller programming), and implement communication protocols (such as 5G module application);Be familiar with cutting-edge fields such as chip technology, wireless communication, image processing, and sensor networks;Be able to solve practical problems using simulation tools (such as Multisim, MATLAB) and development platforms (such as Arduino, FPGA);Adapt to the trends of intelligence and internet of things, and promote the development of electronic information technology towards low power consumption, high integration, and ubiquitous connection.
